description.value: Burnside Gorge Community Association is a neighbourhood community centre in Victoria's Burnside-Gorge area, operated by the Capital Regional District. It offers a wide range of programs including youth recreation, family services, licensed childcare, and community events like the Selkirk Waterfront Festival and Gorge Waterway Cleanup. The centre also manages the Cecelia Ravine Community Gardens and hosts facility rentals.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: wave (12 spaces) at 48m; stands (4 spaces) at 91m. Total: 16 spaces.
